sources.label: Official Tommy Hilfiger UK men's size guide (Tommy Hilfiger sizes: Tops, Outerwear, Casual Shirts chart, cm)

audit: Old source was a retailer (mckennaman.com). Official tops chart XS-3XL with chest and waist ranges in cm and UK/IE, US and EU sizes. The letter-to-UK mapping was off from M up: S covers UK 36-38 (EU 46-48), M is UK 40 (stored 38), L UK 42, XL UK 44, XXL UK 46. Chest: XS 90 -> 88-92, M 100 -> 98-102, XL 112 -> 109-114. Waist was low throughout: XS 76 -> 78-82, M 86 -> 88-92, XL 98 -> 99-104. 3XL added. UK and US columns are identical on the official chart.
